meta.name: Whites 2010
meta.description:
Comedy series set in the kitchen of a country house hotel, following the trials and tribulations of head chef Roland White and his long suffering sous chef Bib.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Chef Roland White, also a budding writer, is spurred on by the news that a publisher is coming to dine in the restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Caroline is annoyed that Roland has not updated the menu, and Roland is put out when a celebrity chef visits the hotel.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Roland is distracted by a beautiful woman, while Bib struggles to make it to the fertility clinic in time.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Roland is used to the restaurant passing health and safety inspections with the help of bribery, but this time there's a new inspector.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Roland finally gets a chance to be in the spotlight when he is invited to do a spot on the TV show Sunday Chefs. It is just a pity he is chosen to do it on a day where they have a function for 300 people at the hotel, much to the annoyance of Bib and Caroline.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Roland searches for a new sous chef now Bib is leaving, while the team prepare for the staff talent show party.
